Archduchess Haarlep

  • In-game
  • Model

Haarlep[1] is an Incubus in the House of Hope. Employed by  Raphael to satisfy his desires, they[2] are in Raphael's personal chambers. Haarlep can be engaged with, in which case they will provide valuable information in exchange for a fiendish sexual encounter. Alternatively, they can be fought, skipping the sexual encounter but losing access to the information.

“
I'm a perfect copy. He only ever wants to sleep with himself. What's better than the devil you know, eh?
„
— Haarlep

Overview

Background

Haarlep was sent by  Mephistopheles to distract his naughty son Raphael. They serve as the devil's main sexual partner, indulging him in his fantasies.

Involvement

Act Three

Haarlep is on Raphael's bed in the House of Hope's boudoir. When approached, they inquire as to what the party is doing. They quickly see through any form of deception, so the interacting party member must be honest or Haarlep becomes irritated and starts a fight.

Intrigued, Haarlep offers valuable information on one condition: one of the party members must "play" with them. If the invitation is accepted, Haarlep commands them to undress and lay on the bed. Before continuing, Haarlep asks whether the talking party member prefers their male or female form (responding that it does not matter causes them to move to the feminine form).

With the party member on the bed, Haarlep then initiates sex with them. The party member can either surrender to Haarlep or resist via a  DC 18 Wisdom Check or  DC 18 Performance Check. Even if successful, Haarlep's charm is too much and the party member must choose: surrender or fight. If they choose to fight, Haarlep is disappointed and combat begins. If the party member surrenders, Haarlep continues to have their way with them and attempts to consume their soul.

The party member is now presented with a final choice. They can surrender their body, but not their mind, in which case Haarlep continues. Haarlep then invites them to surrender their body one last time: if rejected, a fight ensues. If accepted, Haarlep finishes and assumes the party member's form, adding their likeness to Haarlep's shapeshifting repertoire. As thanks, Haarlep provides  Key From Raphael's Safe, letting them know that Raphael's secret safe is behind the painting of himself. Haarlep then departs, informing the party member that from then on, they will periodically be able to feel it when Haarlep sleeps with others using their likeness.

Alternatively, the party member may surrender their body and soul, in which case Haarlep consumes their soul, resulting in a game over if the participant is the main character or a permanent death if they are a companion.

Finally, the party member may resist via a successful  DC 25 Constitution Check, in which case they throw Haarlep off them and begin a fight.

If Haarlep is killed, they can be communed with using  Speak with Dead, where they reveal that the safe containing the information the party seek is in a safe behind Raphael's "vanity", which is the painting on the leftside of Raphael's bed. The Key From Raphael's Safe can be looted from Haarlep's body to open the safe.

Sleeping with Haarlep does not have any negative repercussions on any current romance. However, it locks the party out of gaining the  Helldusk Gloves, and potentially gains the party a humorous line at the end of the House of Hope; if the party member asks Haarlep if Raphael is any good in bed, a verbal riposte is available when Raphael asks if the party have any last words.

Encounter details

Haarlep can be fought by rejecting their invitation to play outright or resisting their advances. If not surprised, silenced or otherwise disabled before being killed, Haarlep summons six Vengeful Imps to assist in the fight. If not summoned by Haarlep, the imps appear when the button to the secret safe is pushed.

If battle was initiated by resisting Haarlep after having begun the sexual encounter, the party member who took off their clothes begins the fight without any of their weapons or equipment, having only their underwear equipped.

The fight itself is not too daunting, though it can become annoying due to Haarlep's passive ability. When attacked, Haarlep can cast  Ethereal Escape as a reaction, allowing them to prevent further damage until the start of their next turn. It can be helpful to inflict a condition on them that prevents reactions (such as dazed, paralysis, or knocking them prone), although  Shocking Grasp is ineffective. Alternatively, baiting out an Attack of Opportunity consumes their reaction. Offensively, they use  Claws.

The imps themselves are not too troublesome as they have low health, however, they continuously cast  Eldritch Blast which can push characters off the boudoir's balcony via  Repelling Blast. It is best to deal with them quickly via area-of-effect spells and focus on Haarlep later.

Characters outside of combat are not revealed if approaching Haarlep under the Ethereal Escape effect, as their line of sight cone is disabled.

Speak with Dead

Haarlep's corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Haarlep
      Haarlep... Incubus... sworn to Raphael.
  • How did you end up here?
    • Haarlep
      Sent by Mephistopheles... distract naughty son.
  • Did Raphael prefer to be on top or beneath you?
    • Haarlep
      Below... never on top... never.
  • How do I reach the Orphic Hammer?
    • Haarlep
      Safe... Secrets.
  • How do I get my contract?
    • Haarlep
      Safe... Secrets.
  • Where does Raphael keep his secrets?
    • Haarlep
      Hidden behind... his... vanity.
  • Did you ever turn into forms besides Raphael's?
    • Haarlep
      Raphael... loves... only... Raphael.
  • Does Raphael have any weaknesses in battle?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*

Notes and references

  1. ↑ The name "Haarlep" is an anagram of Raphael.
  2. ↑ This article uses neutral pronouns for Haarlep. Narration uses both masculine and neutral pronouns. In-game dialogue refers to them as male and as an incubus, while Wiktoria Kubien, who designed most of Haarlep's appearance and clothing, refers to them as "Incubus/Succubus" and uses neutral pronouns. Game files alternate between masculine and neutral, and there are separate data entries for the male and female form. In  Forgotten Realms lore it is not clear if incubi and succubi are separate beings, who can change their sex at will, or if they are two forms of the same being.
